comment_text: Introducing a moratorium until there is a more sustainable framework for these data centres seems entirely reasonable. That and appropriate taxation for the companies. It’s the part about public ownership which muddies the waters.

Also, what is the plan for the inevitable job losses and reduced confidence in gaining a degree? We are already seeing shifts in attitude here in the UK, where graduates are wondering what the point even was. So many entry-level positions are disappearing.
